    This design is a non-invasive Helicobacter pylori (H. pylori) detector, designed for 
children aged 3-12 years old. It adopts Urea Breath Test (UBT) technology, combined with 
the fun interaction of gummy bears (Urea Carbon 13/Carbon 14 capsule), which solves the 
problems of invasiveness of the traditional test and the low degree of cooperation of 
children. The main features of the product include high-precision infrared sensors, two 
blow designs, replaceable mouthpieces, fun design, food-grade non-toxic plastic housing, 
magnetic charging with a miniature solenoid valve, and more. In terms of technical 
support, the product adopts NDIR infrared gas sensor technology, laser-assisted ratio 
analysis, and a gamified design to enhance children's cooperation.
